source_kind: exact local installed primary source, not frozen Git input

claims.claim: JSON response mode owns unresolved response promise and request correlation.

Completed response resolves JSON and deletes request/response correlations; JSON branch does not call stream.cleanup. Per-request object graph can be garbage collected; no ordinary global leak inferred.
Handler receives a per-request signal; Can registered callback ignores second argument.
Settled handler finally releases its own controller; waiting forever is a different lifecycle condition.

limits: No claim HTTP disconnect automatically sends protocol cancellation
No claim per-request cycle is an ordinary long-lived memory leak
Current wrapper has no explicit supported unsettled invocation cancellation/deadline/close handoff
